          echo "UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$RUNNER_TEMP/python-dependency-audit-venv" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$RUNNER_TEMP/python-dependency-audit-venv" uv sync --locked --extra dev --python "$(command -v python)"

      - name: Audit locked runtime and development dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          audit_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/python-dependency-audit"
          mkdir -p "$audit_dir"
          uv --version | tee "$audit_dir/uv-version.txt"
          python --version | tee "$audit_dir/python-version.txt"
          python -m pip_audit --version | tee "$audit_dir/pip-audit-version.txt"
          printf 'PyPI JSON vulnerability service: https://pypi.org/pypi/<package>/<version>/json\n' > "$audit_dir/vulnerability-service.txt"
          uv lock --check
          python -m pip check
          python -m pip list --format=json > "$audit_dir/installed-packages.json"
          python -m pip_audit --local --skip-editable --vulnerability-service pypi --format json --output "$audit_dir/installed.json"
          uv export --locked --no-dev --no-emit-project --format requirements-txt --output-file "$audit_dir/runtime-requirements.txt"
          python -m pip_audit --requirement "$audit_dir/runtime-requirements.txt" --no-deps --disable-pip --strict --vulnerability-service pypi --format json --output "$audit_dir/runtime.json"
          python - "$audit_dir/installed-packages.json" "$audit_dir/installed.json" "$audit_dir/runtime.json" <<'PY'
          import json
          import re
          import sys
          from pathlib import Path

          def fail(message):
              raise SystemExit(message)

          def read_json(path):
              with Path(path).open(encoding="utf-8") as stream:
                  return json.load(stream)

          def package_name(record, label):
              if not isinstance(record, dict):
                  fail(f"{label}: package record is not an object")
              name = record.get("name")
              if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
                  fail(f"{label}: package name is missing")
              return re.sub(r"[-_.]+", "-", name).lower()

          inventory = read_json(sys.argv[1])
          if not isinstance(inventory, list) or not inventory:
              fail("installed package inventory is empty or malformed")
          inventory_names = [package_name(record, "pip list") for record in inventory]
          if len(inventory_names) != len(set(inventory_names)):
              fail("pip list contains duplicate normalized package names")

          def validate_report(path, label, allowed_skips, expected_names=None):
              report = read_json(path)
              if not isinstance(report, dict) or not isinstance(report.get("dependencies"), list):
                  fail(f"{label}: malformed pip-audit report")
              dependencies = report["dependencies"]
              if not dependencies:
                  fail(f"{label}: pip-audit reported no dependencies")
              names = []
              skipped = []
              for record in dependencies:
                  name = package_name(record, label)
                  names.append(name)
                  if "skip_reason" in record:
                      if set(record) != {"name", "skip_reason"} or not isinstance(record["skip_reason"], str):
                          fail(f"{label}: malformed skipped dependency record")
                      skipped.append((name, record["skip_reason"]))
                  else:
                      if not isinstance(record.get("version"), str) or not record["version"] or not isinstance(record.get("vulns"), list):
                          fail(f"{label}: incomplete audited dependency record for {name}")
                      if record["vulns"]:
                          fail(f"{label}: vulnerability findings for {name}")
              if len(names) != len(set(names)):
                  fail(f"{label}: duplicate normalized package names")
              if expected_names is not None and set(names) != expected_names:
                  fail(f"{label}: package inventory mismatch; missing={sorted(expected_names - set(names))}, extra={sorted(set(names) - expected_names)}")
              if sorted(skipped) != sorted(allowed_skips):
                  fail(f"{label}: unexpected skipped dependencies: {skipped!r}")
              print(f"{label}: {len(names) - len(skipped)} audited, {len(skipped)} allowed skips, zero findings")

          validate_report(
              sys.argv[2],
              "installed audit",
              {("slopsearx", "distribution marked as editable")},
              set(inventory_names),
          )
          validate_report(sys.argv[3], "runtime audit", set())
          PY

      - name: Retain dependency audit reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: python-dependency-audit
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/python-dependency-audit/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
